The fruit shop looked quieter than usual that evening. Anna has practiced table tennis for three years and won a prize last term. The experience taught Anna more than any book could. A small salamander hid under the wet log by the creek.

Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. At first, Anna found it difficult to keep the habit. In fact, the fund helps poor families.
Amy advised Anna to try swimming as a new hobby. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Amy and Anna are preparing a report about the fruit shop. A henley layers under flannel.

Anna believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The supermarket has become an important part of daily life. Little by little, things began to change. For example, the merciful king freed all the prisoners that spring.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. On Saturday evenings, Anna reviews the notes from class. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on.
